name: Thinking Cap LMS
description_en:
Thinking Cap LMS is a branded training-delivery platform for employees, professional associations and extended-enterprise audiences. It emphasizes learning paths, certification, commerce and multiple audience portals.

The choice is more than a course player: administrators need to define which audiences, credits, recurring requirements and purchase paths the deployment will support.
description_zh:
Thinking Cap LMS 是面向员工、专业协会及扩展企业人群的品牌培训平台，强调学习路径、认证、电商及多人群门户。

选择时不能只看课程播放器，管理员需定义支持哪些人群、学分、周期要求及采购路径。

core_features.explanation_en: Combine course activities with credits, certificates and badges.
core_features.explanation_zh: 把课程活动与学分、证书及徽章结合。

core_features.explanation_en: Branded portals and segmentation address employees, members or partners.
core_features.explanation_zh: 品牌门户及分组服务员工、会员或伙伴。

core_features.explanation_en: The offering lists subscriptions, bundles, coupons and payment integration.
core_features.explanation_zh: 产品列出订阅、组合、优惠券和支付接入。

use_cases.basis: Illustrative workflow and selection guidance, not observed customer outcomes.

pricing.source_snapshot_en: Personalized demo/trial and sales contact; no public rate or billing meter verified.
pricing.source_snapshot_zh: 有定制演示、试用及销售联系；未核实公开费率或计量单位。

sources.title: ThinkingCap LMS | Home
sources.research_notes_en: Read SCORM/activity paths, certification/credits, commerce and multi-tenant training scope.

sources.title: Contact Us | ThinkingCap LMS
sources.research_notes_en: Read official contact/demo/free-trial entries; no published price or perpetual free tier.

official_check.scope: Public official documentation research; no account, purchase, live workflow, performance, owner identity or publication approval verified.

review_notes: Original English research and corresponding Chinese translation by Codex AI; vendor documentation is not independent product testing.
Examples and fit judgments are editorial guidance. Chinese text does not establish a Chinese product interface.

sections.en: The homepage lists SCORM 1.2/2004, instructor-led activities and custom activity types within learning paths. It describes credits, certificates and badges, ecommerce with subscriptions/bundles/coupons, role-based assignment and multi-tenant portals. Multi-audience branding is useful only when learner and administrator visibility follows the intended boundaries.
sections.zh: 首页列出学习路径中的 SCORM 1.2/2004、讲师课程及自定义活动，介绍学分、证书、徽章、含订阅组合优惠券的电商、按角色分配及多租户门户。多人群品牌能力只有在学员和管理员可见范围符合预期时才有意义。

sections.en: Define a learning path, required credit total and renewal period for a pilot member group. Complete one learner path, leave another incomplete and verify the resulting transcript or certificate. If training is sold, test purchase and expiration against access rules. This is an example of what to evaluate; no recurring certification or payment flow was executed here.
sections.zh: 为试点会员组定义学习路径、所需学分和续期周期。完成一名学员路径，另一名保持未完成，再检查成绩单或证书。若销售培训，应按访问规则测试购买和到期。本例说明需评估的内容，本文未执行周期认证或支付。

sections.title_zh: 通过联系确定价格及服务范围
sections.en: The official contact page offers a personalized demo and a free-trial entry but publishes no numeric price, billing unit or continuing free-plan entitlement. Leave the amount unknown. Request a quote covering learner and tenant counts, commerce, integrations, implementation and support. A certification or security claim on the website does not establish that the proposed deployment meets a particular regulatory requirement.
sections.zh: 官方联系页提供定制演示及免费试用入口，没有公开金额、计费单位或持续免费权益，因此金额保持未知。询价应涵盖学员和租户数、电商、集成、实施及支持。网站上的认证或安全宣传不能证明拟部署环境满足某一监管要求。

sections.title_en: Pilot role and completion rules before expansion
sections.title_zh: 扩展前试点角色和完成规则
sections.en: Begin with one audience, representative content and a named training owner. Verify report exports, permission boundaries and what happens after an interrupted course or failed assessment. The product is relevant when training, credits and multiple audiences need coordinated management. Exact hosting options, source licensing, restoration and contract data location remain unverified.
sections.zh: 先选择一类人群、代表性内容及培训负责人，核对报告导出、权限边界，以及课程中断或考核失败后的行为。培训、学分及多人群需统一管理时可考虑它。具体托管选项、源码许可、恢复及合同数据位置仍未核实。

content_method.author: Codex (AI assistant)
content_method.method: Public primary-source documentation research, original English synthesis and Chinese translation; examples are hypothetical and unexecuted.

research_gaps.en: Verify tenant/learner pricing, recurrence and credit rules, commerce charges, hosting and contract retention.
research_gaps.zh: 需确认租户学员计价、周期及学分规则、电商费用、托管及合同保留期限。

research_gaps.en: No live account, purchase, recovery or performance test was performed.
research_gaps.zh: 未实际创建账户、购买、测试恢复或测量性能。
